These synthetic fixtures were generated with ElevenLabs and transcribed with Speechmatics on 2026-10-02. JSON contains only finalized recognition messages and utterance boundaries. amber.pcm is 24 kHz mono signed 16-bit little-endian PCM (1.068 seconds), used to verify exact adapter audio transfer without credentials or paid API calls. Sentence and normalized-entity transcripts exercise the recorded provider format 2.9.
